team.title: Team
team.description: Everyone who works on OneOhm projects: staff, I&C partner crews and resellers. Roles decide what each person can see and do.
team.search: Search by name, phone, email or ID
team.emptyBody: Try another name or clear the role filter.

form.emailHint: For signing in to the web app.
form.phoneHint: For signing in to the mobile app with a one-time code.
form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it after signing in.
form.newPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password. Setting one signs them out everywhere.
form.rolesHint: Choose at least one. A person can hold several roles.

addDialog.title: Add a person
addDialog.description: They can sign in as soon as you save. Give an email and password for the web, a mobile number for the app, or both.

editSheet.title: Edit person
editSheet.onLeaveHint: New tasks go to someone else in the same role while they are away.
editSheet.activeHint: Turning this off signs them out and keeps their history.
